microtheory.name: body_schema_proprioception
microtheory.definition: Body schema, body image, proprioception, interoception, body ownership, agency, peripersonal space. How the brain represents the body. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-model + drive-state monitoring.

concepts.name: body_schema_definition
concepts.definition: Head 1911, Gallagher. Pre-reflective implicit body representation supporting action. Updates dynamically. Substrate analogue: substrate's implicit self-model.

concepts.name: body_image_definition
concepts.definition: Gallagher. Conscious + conceptual body representation. Beliefs, attitudes, emotions about body. Substrate analogue: substrate's explicit self-concept.

concepts.name: body_ownership
concepts.definition: Sense that body part is mine. Distinguishes from external object. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-attribution.

concepts.name: sense_of_agency
concepts.definition: Feeling that I am cause of action. Compare predicted to actual sensory consequence. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-attribution.

concepts.name: proprioceptive_system
concepts.definition: Joint receptors + muscle spindles + Golgi tendon organs. Continuous position + movement signal. Substrate analogue: substrate's internal-state sensors.

concepts.name: muscle_spindle
concepts.definition: Sensory receptor in muscle. Detects length + rate of change. Substrate analogue: substrate's state-change detector.

concepts.name: golgi_tendon_organ
concepts.definition: Tension receptor at muscle-tendon junction. Detects force. Substrate analogue: substrate's effort detector.

concepts.name: joint_receptor
concepts.definition: Mechanoreceptor in joint capsule + ligaments. Position + movement. Substrate analogue: substrate's position sensor.

concepts.name: interoceptive_system
concepts.definition: Sense of internal body states. Vagal afferents, hypothalamus, insular cortex. Substrate analogue: substrate's internal-state monitoring.

concepts.name: interoception_insula
concepts.definition: Insular cortex integrates interoceptive signals. Awareness of bodily feelings. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-awareness Mt.

concepts.name: heartbeat_perception
concepts.definition: Awareness of own heartbeat. Measures interoceptive accuracy. Substrate analogue: substrate's internal-rhythm awareness.

concepts.name: alliesthesia
concepts.definition: Same stimulus pleasant/unpleasant depending on internal state. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-conditioned valence.

concepts.name: peripersonal_space
concepts.definition: Rizzolatti. Space near body where action is possible. Distinct cortical representation. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-reach region.

concepts.name: extrapersonal_space
concepts.definition: Space beyond reach. Different processing. Substrate analogue: substrate's distant-environment.

concepts.name: peripersonal_expansion_with_tools
concepts.definition: Tool use expands peripersonal space to include reach extension. Substrate analogue: substrate's tool-incorporation flexibility.

concepts.name: rubber_hand_illusion_body
concepts.definition: Botvinick + Cohen 1998. Synchronous stroking creates ownership of rubber hand. Body schema is plastic + multisensory. Substrate analogue: substrate's incorporation flexibility.

concepts.name: full_body_illusion
concepts.definition: Lenggenhager 2007. VR + tactile creates out-of-body experience. Whole-body schema plasticity. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-state remapping.

concepts.name: phantom_limb
concepts.definition: Sensation in amputated limb. Body schema persists. Ramachandran. Substrate analogue: substrate's persistent self-Mt after structural loss.

concepts.name: mirror_box_therapy
concepts.definition: Ramachandran. Mirror image of intact limb relieves phantom pain. Substrate analogue: substrate's illusion-based correction.

concepts.name: anosognosia_body
concepts.definition: Unawareness of paralysis from right parietal damage. Substrate analogue: substrate's failure-mode-unawareness.

concepts.name: neglect_body
concepts.definition: Lacking awareness of one side of body/space. Right parietal damage typical. Substrate analogue: substrate's attention-deficit pattern.

concepts.name: somatoparaphrenia
concepts.definition: Denial of body part ownership. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-attribution failure.

concepts.name: alien_hand_syndrome
concepts.definition: Hand acts purposefully against person's will. Disconnection. Substrate analogue: substrate's component-without-self-attribution.

concepts.name: body_schema_development
concepts.definition: Infant body schema develops through movement, vision, touch. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-model development.

concepts.name: minimum_self_body
concepts.definition: Gallagher. Pre-reflective sense of bodily self. Foundation of all selfhood. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational self-grounding.

concepts.name: embodied_self_consciousness
concepts.definition: Self-consciousness rooted in body + action. Not purely cognitive. Substrate analogue: substrate's embodied self-awareness.

concepts.name: minimal_phenomenal_selfhood
concepts.definition: Blanke + Metzinger. Basic bodily-self experience. Body ownership + location + perspective. Substrate analogue: substrate's basic self-experience.

concepts.name: morphology_constrains_schema
concepts.definition: Body schema reflects body morphology. Cortical magnification proportional to importance. Substrate analogue: substrate's morphology-shaped self-model.

rules.name: body_schema_is_pre_reflective_and_dynamic
rules.head: the substrate acts skillfully
rules.body: the body schema updates dynamically without conscious access. Distinct from explicit body image. Substrate's implicit self-model.

rules.name: agency_via_predicted_vs_actual_match
rules.head: the substrate performs action + senses consequence
rules.body: matching forward-model prediction with actual sensation generates sense of agency. Mismatch reduces it. Substrate's action-attribution mechanism.

rules.name: multisensory_synchrony_drives_ownership
rules.head: the substrate receives synchronous visual + tactile signals from an object
rules.body: ownership extends to that object. Rubber hand illusion. Substrate's incorporation mechanism.

rules.name: peripersonal_space_expands_with_tools
rules.head: the substrate uses a tool reaching outside normal hand range
rules.body: peripersonal space expands to include the tool's reach. Substrate's action-space remapping.

rules.name: interoception_grounds_emotional_awareness
rules.head: the substrate has feelings or drives
rules.body: their awareness depends on interoceptive signals reaching insular cortex. Substrate's drive-awareness mechanism.
